column6: Both paragraphs express gratitude for contributions to the completion of a book, emphasizing excellence and lasting impact. The slight variations in wording do not alter the overall meaning or intent.
column7: Thank you all for your dedication to excellence and for helping me bring this book to completion. Your contributions have made a lasting impact, and I am truly grateful.
